0022600031.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, 10th in the West) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (6-3, 8th in the West) after the Pelicans have won four straight, while Minnesota has won its last two. The Pelicans are without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise) and have Trey Murphy III listed as day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision, while the Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery) and have Terrence Shannon Jr. day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season the Pelicans lost the series 1-3, including a 132-126 loss in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
